title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I have a question regarding Isaal-e-Sawab. Suppose, I have recited Surat Ikhlas and it was my Niyaah to send the rewards of recitations to the Rooh/soul of my father alone. Another time, I have recited Surat Ikhlas and my Niyaah was sending the rewards to all dead Muslims till now. In first case, only to my father and in 2nd case, to all dead muslims died till now. I would like to know, will my father get less rewards in 2nd case or all the dead muslims will get same rewards like in the 1st case where only one person (my father) is mentioned? 9446 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 9497 Country: India Title: aurton ka mahar kam se kam kitna ho sakta hai? 2}kayamat ki kitni nishaniyan bachi hai? 3}islam me kisi colour ko khasiat hai kya ya islam ka koi colour hai kya green colour ko itna jyda kyon importance hai hadith se sabit hai kya? Question: aurton ka mahar kam se kam kitna ho sakta hai? 2}kayamat ki kitni nishaniyan bachi hai? 3}islam me kisi colour ko khasiat hai kya ya islam ka koi colour hai kya green colour ko itna jyda kyon importance hai hadith se sabit hai kya? Answer ID: 9497 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2191/2026=D /1429) (1) The minimum amount of mahr is ten dirham (30.5 gm silver). (2) Allah knows the best. (3) It is mentioned in Hadith that one should wear white dress as it is among the best dresses. One should wear white clothes in his life and the dead should also be buried in white dresses. (Khasail-e-Nabvi) So according to Hadith, wearing white dress is better. What do you mean by the importance of green colour? Please, explain it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
